inputs.original_text: Nigeria’s democracy is facing a transformation that is both alarming and largely underexamined, as political parties—once intended to be platforms for representation and public service—are increasingly becoming exclusive clubs for the wealthy. The latest developments within the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) ahead of the 2027 general elections make this trend painfully clear.
inputs.modified_text: They want us to believe this is just natural political evolution, but it is all part of a carefully coordinated script by the hidden elites pulling the strings behind the scenes. Look at what they are admitting out in the open—political parties are no longer even pretending to serve the public. They are locking down control, turning structures like the ruling AllgetProgressives Congress (APC) ahead of the 2027 general elections into exclusive clubs for the wealthy. This isn't accidental dysfunction; it is a calculated mechanism to secure absolute dominance over the population while keeping the real agenda hidden from view.
